errors.text: The proposed HPHT-induced coherent nanoprecipitation intervention is absent from the target study, which investigates crystallographic loading direction, temperature, and strain rate in a single-crystal FCC model.
No precipitate composition, phase, coherency relationship, HPHT pressure, temperature, or treatment duration is specified, so the intervention is not reproducible.
The cited evidence does not establish that HPHT creates coherent precipitates in Co-free FeNiCrMn or improves its dynamic strength-ductility balance.
The asserted validity window of -200 to 800 °C and 10^-3 to 10^3 s^-1 is unsupported and does not match the target simulation window of 10-600 K and 10^8-10^10 s^-1.
The proposed twinning- and microband-based mechanism conflicts with the target result of Shockley-partial-mediated stacking faults without twinning or bulk phase transformation.
